title: The UP-CLOSE Magic Experience! Downtown Phoenix
includes: Admission ticket to "The UP-CLOSE Magic Experience!"
Exclusive discounted valet parking at hotel for show guests only
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: AC in the summer? You betcha!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
CALLING ALL MAGIC LOVERS! LAUGH, Have FUN and Be AMAZED with the BEST Magicians from America’s Got Talent, Penn & Teller's Fool Us, Masters of Illusion, the Vegas Strip, Broadway, and More! 

YOU WON'T BELIEVE YOUR EYES! So get ready for 90 minutes of high-octane Magic, Comedy, and FUN. For this up-close mind-adventure, the magicians perform inches away under the scrutiny of four exclusive rows of lucky guests. 

GET TICKETS to this interactive experience to AMP UP to your next level of date nights, anniversaries, birthdays, and special nights out!
